document_type: selected working IPS proposal for the 22 October initial decision record
status: user approved for inclusion in the group's proposed policy on 2026-10-21; not trustee authorization or evidence of submission

goal_inflation_policy.use: CPI defines the primary pass/fail test for the $8m real purchasing-power goal. HEPI is reported separately as an education-cost stress and is not blended with CPI or substituted for the primary test.
goal_inflation_policy.status: user selected for inclusion in the group's proposed IPS on 2026-10-21; trustee authorization pending
known_limitations: CPI 2.5% is a planning assumption anchored approximately to the 30 December 2022 Treasury-TIPS par-yield spread, not a guaranteed CPI forecast.
HEPI reflects higher-education operating costs and may not match Kappa's scholarship or learning-centre cost basket; 3.0% is a stress assumption, not a forecast.

mandatory_payment_funding.base_case: Purchase Beta with $2.4m face value to cover the full 31 December 2024 payment. Keep Delta coupons separate from the liability reserve; base reinvestment rate is 0% unless an authorized alternative is documented.
mandatory_payment_funding.coupon_use_alternatives: One- and two-coupon Delta variants remain sensitivity cases only; they do not replace the selected base funding rule.
mandatory_payment_funding.status: user confirmed the full-Beta base on 2026-10-21

sensitivity_case.interpretation: Case bond quotes treated as all-in; lower friction for liquid ETFs; same direct-stock friction. Report separately from base and do not mix fee schedules within a portfolio comparison.

transaction_cost_policy.status: user confirmed the base and separate sensitivity treatment on 2026-10-21; transaction-cost rates remain planning assumptions where the assignment supplies no explicit fee schedule

primary_loss_measure.method: cash-flow-adjusted unitized total-return drawdown from the sleeve's prior unit-value peak
primary_loss_measure.academic_historical_frequency: month-end; intramonth drawdown is not observed in the saved monthly analysis
primary_loss_measure.operational_monitoring_frequency: weekly proposed, subject to available current data
primary_loss_measure.whole_fund_stress_and_obligation_coverag: reported separately; either can trigger review regardless of growth-sleeve drawdown

trigger_ladder.action: Within 2 business days validate prices, distributions, unitization, cash flows, obligation coverage, stress, and goal funding; report to Investment Committee.
Investment Committee meets within 5 business days and documents whether to hold, make a separately pre-authorized rule-based rebalance, or submit a prospective policy change to trustees.
Notify trustees the same or next business day; suspend discretionary risk-increasing actions pending review; document funding status, action owner, decision date, and recovery conditions.

trigger_ladder.trigger: any actual or credible prospective shortfall of a mandatory payment
trigger_ladder.action: Escalate immediately regardless of drawdown; produce a dated funding plan and make only the transactions needed to restore due-date coverage, subject to authorized decision makers.

upside_goal_protection.status: user selected the principle and CPI/HEPI goal convention for inclusion in the proposed IPS on 2026-10-21; trustee authorization, eligible instrument, valuation convention, and annual review process remain to be approved
upside_goal_protection.review_frequency: annual, and after a material change in mandate, liabilities, or available resources
upside_goal_protection.principle: If the 2030 real goal remains fully funded after a 30% decline in the growth sleeve, protect only the minimum amount required for the goal in an eligible asset matched to the goal date; leave any surplus invested under the approved growth policy.
test_sequence: Reconfirm dated mandatory payments and reserve their cash flows first; do not count earmarked assets or coupons twice.
Recalculate the remaining 2030 nominal goal using the single inflation index approved for the goal; retain any second index as a separately labelled mission-cost sensitivity.
Use market prices, executable yields, transaction costs, and permitted assets observable on the review date; do not reuse 2022 case bond quotes as future prices.

Apply a -30% shock to the remaining growth sleeve and verify that the goal is still fully funded by eligible goal-matched assets plus shocked residual growth assets under the approved valuation convention.

If the test passes, determine the smallest transfer from growth assets into a permitted maturity-matched instrument that secures the goal; keep the excess in the growth sleeve. If it fails, do not claim the goal is secured and do not increase risk merely to catch up.
Record funding ratio, stress result, amount transferred, remaining growth risk, transaction cost, owner, and approval. No automatic action solely because the portfolio gained a fixed percentage.
upside_goal_protection.funding_gap_response: If the stress test fails, report the dollar shortfall and revised required return; prioritize obligation coverage and risk control, diagnose whether the gap reflects market-wide conditions or portfolio underperformance, and submit any strategic change for authorized approval.

interpretation.10_15_20_are: governance review and escalation triggers, not guaranteed maximum loss limits
interpretation.breach_rule: the highest reached trigger governs, including when prices gap past a lower trigger
interpretation.exception: any crisis deferral applies only to discretionary action, needs written authorized approval, a dated expiry, and regular review; it cannot reduce due-date payment coverage
interpretation.growth_asset_sale_condition: only after checking data, obligations, approved bands/limits, thesis, transaction amount, replacement asset, and authorized decision; no sale solely because a trigger was touched

whether concentration limits are hard policy or sensitivity cases
permitted goal-matching instrument and valuation/approval convention for implementing the selected -30% upside goal-protection test
